  > 
  > For the figures I generate (matplotlib, vector PDF, sized so no rescaling happens in the document), I need from the chosen venue's latest template:
  > - text width and column layout (single column? figure* widths) in inches/pt, and the body text size;
  > - the smallest type size the venue accepts inside figures and tables (axis labels, tick labels, legends, table body), or the venue's own statement if it gives none;
  > - how many main-text pages and whether figure/table count is limited; whether appendix figures count;
  > - required figure conventions (colour/grayscale printing, font embedding / Type 1 only, caption placement, table style such as booktabs, any `\includegraphics` rules).
  > 
  > Waits on this: final sizes of all exhibits. Until you answer I use a 5.5 in text width and ≥8 pt text in figures as a stand-in, and will rerender when you answer.
